=== dossier/README.md
# Dossier

This folder is the living memory of the relationship: seven files, each one topic, each line
dated and sourced.

One fact per line. Every line carries a date and a source (a transcript timestamp, a mail, a
file and page). A line without a source is an opinion and says so.

Correct a line rather than add a contradictory one. Each file opens with its own dated header
line, updated whenever the file changes.

- `ACTORS.md` — who is who on every side, grouped by side.
- `HISTORY.md` — chronology, commitments in progress, upcoming.
- `LEARNINGS.md` — how the counterpart speaks and thinks, what the case teaches.
- `TONE.md` — the voice, what is established, the Refused log.
- `CHANNELS.md` — how we communicate and this repository's confidentiality level.
- `OPEN-QUESTIONS.md` — answered, still open, what we would ask the end client.
- `RELATIONSHIP.md` — status, numbers, views, improvements, opportunities.

=== outbound/README.md
# Outbound

Every file in this folder opens with a status header, verbatim:

```
Status: draft | reviewed by <name> | sent <date time> by <name>
To: <recipient>
Subject: <subject>            (mails)
Deadline: YYYY-MM-DD          (optional: when the draft has to be sent)
Written by: <human or "agent session, YYYY-MM-DD">
Rules: no confidential names; see knowledge/DOCTRINE.md
```

Files are named `YYYY-MM-DD_slug` (plus their extension).

- `deliverables/` — a rendered file keeps its source file beside it, same stem.
- `mails/` — one file per message.
- `calls/` — preparation, then minutes.

Two standing rules: no confidential name ever appears in a file under this folder, and nothing
leaves this repository without a human sending it.

# Call with the ordering party, 2026-10-12

## Context

Second call with Jane Doe (Acme Consulting), following the kickoff of 2026-10-01. Video call, 30 minutes (call 2026-10-01 @21:40). The pilot starts with one site (call 2026-10-01 @21:40). We owe a quote by 2026-10-16 (call 2026-10-01 @25:10).

## Agenda (30 minutes)

- 0:00-0:03 Opening, confirm camera and recording etiquette
- 0:03-0:10 Who signs the order on their side
- 0:10-0:20 Pilot: which site, go-live date, who joins
- 0:20-0:27 Next steps and the quote timeline
- 0:27-0:30 Recap of who does what by when

## Open questions, in order of priority

1. Who signs the order on the ordering party's side? Decides who we commit to in writing. Ask first thing.
2. Is the go-live date of the pilot firm? Sets the final week of the pilot. Needed before the quote is sent.
3. Do the end client's field teams join the pilot? Changes the training effort we quote. Likely premature until the pilot site list arrives; ask whether a date exists for it.
4. Which site is the first one? She wants a single site, but no site has been named in our records.

## Boundaries

- Give no price. A price before the pilot scope is signed is off-limits (decision 2026-09-21 by Sam). If she asks, commit only to the quote by 2026-10-16.
- Do not name the end client in anything written or sent after the call.
- Consent to record is not recorded in this repository (`dossier.yaml`). Ask before any recording starts.

## Commitments to restate

- Ours: the quote for the pilot by 2026-10-16.
- Theirs: none recorded yet. Try to leave with at least one (the site list, the go-live date, the signatory).

## After the call

- Add the minutes below.
- Update `dossier/HISTORY.md`, `dossier/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md`, `dossier/ACTORS.md`, and `dossier/LEARNINGS.md`. These are still mostly empty, and `dossier/ACTORS.md` has no entry for Jane Doe.

## Minutes
